concrete_patch.why_not_quota_first: Quota discovery is useful but a different CPU-time unit and hierarchy scope. Current ComputeThreads.cpp15 observes affinity only. A correct Linux reader must resolve cgroupv1/v2/mount namespaces and ancestor constraints; an observed quota is not a per-game reserved CPU count. Add rational/unknown provenance first if later requested, not a guessed /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max→integer allocation or automatic participant clamp hidden in this adapter.

novel_calibration_findings.issue: Serial batch service vs user completion latency
novel_calibration_findings.detail: Both jobs must have arrivaltime0 for throughput comparison. Record launch/service, queue wait, and arrival-to-completion independently. Otherwise serial second job queue disappears and fast-simulation latency appears artificially better.

novel_calibration_findings.issue: Counterbalance is currently across layouts/GPU, not within fixed workload
novel_calibration_findings.detail: A first/second seed can have different length and cold GPU/cache state. Serial orderAB vs concurrent startsAB cannot isolate this with one batch. Preserve16 as descriptive screen; later matched replication must swap serial seed order within the same layout/GPU and define cold/setup state, with explicit additionalcount rather than silently adding runs.

novel_calibration_findings.issue: Same global allocation does not mean work-conserving throughput
novel_calibration_findings.detail: If one concurrent game ends early, the other remains on its fixed halfmask because compute is session-frozen. The16 design measures two-job fixedpartition policy, not steady-state backlog throughput or optimalsharing. Report unused allocation/finished-job intervals, do not infer universal efficient-throughput defaults.

novel_calibration_findings.issue: Concurrent memory peak and censors need exact scope
novel_calibration_findings.detail: Sum of per-game peakRSS is only an upper bound, not observed simultaneous machinepeak. Use aligned timestamped nativeRSS/PSS samples or label the bound. Keep per-game1h servicecaps and batch observation/makespan separate so serial queue has no hidden extra completion horizon.

limits: No source edits/builds/games/candidate adoption. Names remain intents; adaptive tiers/quotas/physicaldevices not claimed.
